verdict.rationale: Avalara's API reference page advertises interactive API documentation and an API Explorer with sample payloads, response examples, endpoints, parameters and authentication requirements. Per-method reference pages exist for endpoints like CreateTransaction and CreateNexus, and a no-credit-card 90-day trial grants the API access needed to execute calls. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that examples can be run in-browser (the Explorer is described as for 'reviewing'), any hands-on or independent corroboration, and a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probe got 404s at all candidate paths).
